blocks.text: Is chapter mein students code ki testing (jaanch) aur debugging (ghaltiyan dhoond kar theek karna) ke zaroori tareeqe seekhenge taake un ke programs sahi chalein. Woh samjhenge ke qabil-e-bharosa (reliable) applications banane ke liye testing kyun zaroori hai, aur programming ki aam ghaltiyan (errors) aur bugs kaun se hain. Chapter mein Python ke unittest aur pytest modules se unit testing hai, aur test cases likhne aur chalane ka tareeqa. Students debugging bhi seekhenge: breakpoints lagana, watch expressions istemal karna aur step-by-step (qadam ba qadam) debugging. Is ke baad chapter exception handling samjhata hai aur kai qism ke exceptions ko achhi tarah sambhalna. Aakhir mein students profiling aur optimization ke tareeqe dekhenge jin se program ki raftar (performance) napi jati hai aur code ke sust hisse (bottlenecks) pehchane jate hain.

blocks.title: Testing aur debugging
blocks.text: Testing program ko jaanchna hai taake yaqeeni ho ke woh durust chalta aur mutawaqqa output deta hai. Debugging program ki ghaltiyan (bugs) dhoondna aur theek karna hai.

blocks.prompt: Testing aur debugging mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Testing jaanchti hai ke program mutawaqqa nataij deta hai ya nahi aur batati hai ke kuch ghalat hai; debugging maloom masle ki wajah dhoond kar use theek karti hai.

items: Testing: kya program sahi output deta hai?
Debugging: bugs dhoondna aur theek karna.
Is chapter mein: unit tests, breakpoints, watches, exceptions, profiling.
